decision.framing: 4-byte BE length N of body only; N=0 refused; pre-helloAck N <= 65536; afterwards N <= negotiated maxControlFrameBytes in [65536, 16777216]. Handwritten, not generated.

bodies.hello: controlMajor; expectedStableId UUID-lowercase; admittedManifestDigest ^[0-9a-f]{64}$; platform; maxControlFrameBytesOffer 65536..16777216; subprotocolOffers[<=128]{role 1..128 bytes, roleSubprotocol 1..128 bytes, subprotocolVersion 1..2^53-1}

bodies.refusal: family RF-1..RF-8; supportedControlMajors[1..16] iff RF-1; decisionClass PR-1..PR-9 iff RF-6; detail <= 1024 bytes optional
bodies.effectRequest: effectClass HE-1|HE-2; authorizationRef 1..1024 bytes; operationRef 1..1024 bytes
bodies.effectResult: requestSeq, decisionSeq, outcomeSeq uint53 (outcomeSeq > decisionSeq); commitClass REVERSIBLE|IRREVERSIBLE; effectOutcome COMPLETED|FAILED|INDETERMINATE; resultRef optional 1..1024 bytes
